verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a speech-to-text API. Plugging external MCP servers in so the product can call their tools is an MCP-client/host role, which is a category error for a transcription service. The evidence documents only the opposite role: Speech is Cheap runs its own hosted MCP server for AI assistants to connect to. That server-side evidence does not transfer to this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
